verdict.rationale: SerpApi documents structured JSON output of parsed search results, including organic, news, and other result types, and its Events API explicitly returns titles, dates, and links. Its Brave AI Mode API also returns references. These suggest per-result citation fields, but no evidence shows the specific URL, title, and published-date fields on organic or news results. missing for 10: documented link/title/date field schema for organic and Google News results, evidence that URLs are canonical rather than redirect or tracking links, published-date coverage, independent or hands-on corroboration.
